message.reasoning_content: Spector produced Let It Be tracks incl. "Dig It"? Actually Spector produced "Dig It" and "Maggie Mae" and "One After 909", "Across the Universe", "The Long and Winding Road", "I Me Mine". "What's the New Mary Jane" was an outtake; Spector did work on it but it was never officially released. Safer: Can You Dig It?
